sweep_method: Beyond the mechanical gates: (1) PyYAML walk of .github/workflows/ci.yml over all 21 jobs for container-without-composite and leftover inline safe.directory steps — the single hit, flash-attn-compile, was opened step-by-step and is correct (its submodule-init git at step index 1 precedes the composite at index 3, so its own mark is required, not a leftover); (2) grep of the full diff for every new Display/FromStr/as_db_str/from_db_str impl (one hit, RootIdentity's Display, with no FromStr counterpart); (3) grep of all four K5 migration pin sites plus the EXPECTED_MIGRATION_NAMES tail for the new column; (4) grep of every reader of manifest.artifact across store/version.rs, store/freshness.rs and store/mod.rs, each opened; (5) grep of every read_materialization_manifest call site (20 hits) and manual read of all three production Ok(None) consumer arms; (6) grep of crates/jammi-server and crates/jammi-wire for list_gang_members to bound RPC exposure, plus a git-diff --stat confirming both crates are untouched; (7) the identity attack read RootIdentity::of and canonical_local_root against StorageUrl::parse/parse_scheme, object_store::path::Path::parse, and all four of the store's own build_s3/build_gcs/build_azure/build_r2 bucket-split and from_env sites, cross-checked against the vendored object_store-0.14.1 aws/azure builder env-key documentation.

Swept the whole class rather than the single reported spelling: for each of the four cloud arms of endpoint_of (instance.rs:328-354) I opened the matching builder in crates/jammi-db/src/storage/builder.rs (build_s3 :67-88, build_gcs :120-130, build_azure :164-196, build_r2 :254-257) and then read object_store 0.13.2's own FromStr key table and from_env prefix filter for each provider (aws/builder.rs:493-523 and :587-599; azure/builder.rs FromStr arms and :512-529; gcp/builder.rs FromStr arms and :274-286), plus the endpoint-resolution sites that decide which value actually dials (aws/builder.rs:869-871 with_endpoint, :1209 s3_endpoint.or(endpoint), :1215-1220 bucket_endpoint; azure/builder.rs:946-952 account_url). Every env-reachable location determinant honoured by a builder was then checked against the identity's arm, which yielded four siblings beyond the S3 one: Azure AZURE_STORAGE_ENDPOINT/AZURE_ENDPOINT (and AZURE_USE_FABRIC_ENDPOINT, AZURE_STORAGE_USE_EMULATOR), the R2 arm reading no env while AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 overrides its configured endpoint in the store, and GCS GOOGLE_BASE_URL refuting the 'gs:// namespace is global' premise. Migration append-only was swept by full name-list prefix diff rather than by inspecting the new entry alone.

Full determinant-class sweep beyond the mechanical gates: each of the four *_determinants functions read against object_store 0.13.2's own FromStr key table and build() host resolution (aws/builder.rs:493-548 and :1209; azure/builder.rs:418-477 and :923-954; gcp/builder.rs:207-229 and :544), plus a grep for every direct std::env read in src/aws, src/gcp and src/azure to catch host values that bypass the key tables entirely (one hit: AZURITE_BLOB_STORAGE_URL at azure/builder.rs:929; all others are credential paths). BuilderSeeds::from_vars prefix filters compared against all three from_env implementations. region, virtual_hosted_style_request and s3_express considered and cleared as URL-form-only. The one hit was confirmed by an executed standalone probe, not by reading.

sweep_method: Two enumerations beyond the mechanical gates. (1) Every std::env::var / std::env::vars_os in object_store-0.13.2's aws/, gcp/, azure/ builder, client and credential modules, each classified host-determining vs credential-scoped: url_from_env has exactly one call site (azure/builder.rs:929, now mirrored); the three vars_os walks are the key tables BuilderSeeds mirrors; gcp/builder.rs:277 (SERVICE_ACCOUNT) and azure/builder.rs:524 (IDENTITY_ENDPOINT) are credential-scoped, correctly excluded. No unmirrored bare host read remains. (2) Every ConfigValue<bool> flag the jammi determinant functions read (the two flag() call sites at builder.rs:616 and :642), probed over all five true-spellings object_store's Parse for bool accepts plus two case variants, via a probe crate path-depending on this worktree's jammi-db.

No hard-block class exists, so nothing to enumerate. Beyond the mechanical gates I swept the value-resolution class the brief named: enumerated every `ConfigValue<T>` field in object_store 0.13.2's aws/azure/gcp builders by grep (12 + 5 + 1) and classified each as location-determining or not; traced each host-determining field from `get_config_value` through `build()` to the dialled URL (aws/builder.rs:1210-1219 bucket_endpoint, azure/builder.rs:923-956 both arms, azure/client.rs:173-178 path_url, gcp/builder.rs:544-552 + gcp/client.rs:156) and compared against the identity's read at crates/jammi-db/src/storage/builder.rs:509-668; verified the `url` crate is a single version in Cargo.lock; and ran an executed probe against the real builder for the boolean class. Advisory sibling sites of the raw-endpoint shape, for the lead's fold: crates/jammi-db/src/storage/builder.rs:653 (Azure endpoint), :528 (S3 endpoint), :559 (R2 endpoint) — GCS at :587 is exact because the driver uses base_url verbatim.

read object_store 0.13.2 build()'s bucket_endpoint match (src/aws/builder.rs:1214-1222) and the Azure build() URL resolution (src/azure/builder.rs:918-975, url_from_env :1063-1075), enumerated every input each arm consumes against the keys the determinant readers actually consult, then ran an executed probe (probe-vh) confirming both the identity-side collapse and the driver-side wire divergence. Two sibling sites share the identical resolution code (s3_determinants, r2_determinants) plus the oracle that claims to cover the surface; the zonal_endpoint/s3_express arm is the same shape but was not demonstrated; region was checked and correctly excluded (global AWS bucket namespace)

Beyond the mechanical gates: (1) enumerated every AmazonS3ConfigKey/GoogleConfigKey/AzureConfigKey FromStr spelling in object_store 0.13.2 and classified each as location-determining or not, confirming no `url` key exists on any of the three builders (so build()'s parse_url override is unreachable — jammi never calls with_url) and that every location-determining key is read back through get_config_value on the same builder build_object_store dials with; (2) read the driver's build() bucket_endpoint match, parse_bucket_az, the region default and the private bool parser against their mirrors, line by line; (3) executed a probe crate against the real AmazonS3 driver with static credentials, comparing location_determinants_with output to the URL the driver actually dials, over unset / empty-endpoint / empty-region — which surfaced and then bounded the one present() divergence; (4) grepped the diff for RPC and wire-surface changes across jammi-wire/jammi-server/jammi-client (none) and read the list_gang_members SQL for the enforced row predicate. class_enumeration is empty because no hard-block violation was found; the empty-value sibling sites are listed in the residual check's detail instead.
